tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the project notes to understand the logistics RAG backend and pixel-library workspace metaphor.

tour.title: Backend Application Surface
tour.description: Follow the FastAPI entry point and schemas to see the HTTP API, protected writes, RAG endpoints, and game-world routes.

tour.title: RAG Ingestion and Indexing
tour.description: Review document conversion, ingestion, metadata normalization, profile selection, and vector index construction.

tour.title: Retrieval and Game Mapping
tour.description: Connect RAG query behavior to the game-world service that turns metadata into rooms, shelves, and interactions.

tour.title: Playable Frontend
tour.description: Inspect the React app, API client, character options, movement logic, shared types, and styles that make the first screen playable.

tour.title: MCP Forwarder
tour.description: Understand how the standalone MCP package exposes backend capabilities without duplicating business logic.

tour.title: Behavioral Safety Net
tour.description: Use the backend tests to understand expected contracts for upload, ingestion, retrieval, metadata filtering, profiles, and game interactions.
